findings.statement: The March 23, 2026 SEC/CFTC joint interpretation explicitly lists XRP as a digital commodity; digital commodities are not themselves securities under the interpretation.

The same interpretation says a non-security crypto asset may still be offered or sold subject to an investment contract; the August 2025 SEC final judgment, $125,035,150 penalty and injunction against Ripple remained in effect after appeals were dismissed.
CFTC records show Bitnomial XRP US Dollar Spot Contract certified April 21, 2026 and XRP US Dollar Hecto Perpetual Futures certified May 14, 2026.
Bitnomial's current schedule lists XRP at a 40% haircut and $15M notional limit; BTC and ETH receive lower haircuts and higher limits.

CFTC Letter 26-05, requested by Coinbase Financial Markets, provides conditional no-action relief for FCMs to consider DCO-accepted non-security digital assets after the initial three-month period and notice requirements.
Payward completed acquisition of Bitnomial on May 1, 2026 and controls the FCM/DCM/DCO stack.
RLUSD was included in the November 2025 Bitnomial announcement but is omitted from the October 2026 accepted-collateral schedule.

Kamilah Stevenson's Dec 6, 2025 title is substantiated in the limited Bitnomial sense and later supported by XRP's digital-commodity classification and certified Bitnomial products; it is not a universal CFTC collateral approval and does not establish equal risk treatment to gold, Treasuries or major FX.
